sql.if: AND t1.colec_log_reg_dt < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{srchEndDd} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1 day'

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: CollectionLogMapper.selectCollectionLogCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_collectionlog t1 WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CollectionLogMapper.selectCollectionLogList */ t1.colec_log_id , t1.colec_log_regr_id , t1.colec_log_regr_nm , t1.colec_log_data -> 'mapping' AS colec_mapping_str , to_char(t1.colec_log_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS colec_log_reg_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_collectionlog t1 WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CollectionLogMapper.selectCollectionLog */ t1.colec_log_id , t1.colec_log_regr_id , t1.colec_log_regr_nm , to_char(t1.colec_log_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS colec_log_reg_dt , t1.colec_log_data -> 'mapping' AS colec_mapping_str FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_collectionlog t1 WHERE t1.colec_log_id = #{colecLogId}
